t: You're on Chelsea Manor Street, in Chelsea. It runs roughly north to south, starting at Britten Street, crossing the King's Road, and ending at St Loo Avenue. Its southern continuation, Cheyne Gardens, carries on down to Cheyne Walk by the river. Patrick Pakenham, who lived from 1937 to 2005, made his home on this street. The material doesn't say more about him, so I'll leave it there. It's a street that links the busy King's Road to the quieter riverside.
